title: feat(nmsimsy): simultaneous M and O at t+1 on #7211: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Simultaneous M and O at t+1 on the #7211 y-probes. Its runner is the band's most explicit saturation proof: it computes O at formation+32 and asserts O(t+1)==O(t+32) at all four probes. Also asserts the two-site seed gives identical M, O and intersection here.
